buySellOrder.question: Is there a specific order to buying and selling on your turn?

firstSellRound.question: When can you first sell shares in a company?
firstSellRound.answer: In the second SR. But if it has not yet operated, you receive the price it is at after moving down.

poolLimit.question: Does the bank pool have a per-company share limit?

certLimit.question: Player certificate limits
certLimit.answer: | 24 | 18 | 15 | 13 | 11 |  |  |  | Only certificates in companies having more than one share count towards the limit

sameCompanyBuySell.question: Can you buy a certificate and immediately sell a certificate in the same company?
sameCompanyBuySell.answer: No. All selling precedes all buying.

roundEnd.question: What ends a share dealing round?
roundEnd.answer: Each player consecutively passing. The priority, and subsequent places, are then assigned according to cash held.

initialTile.question: Where can you make an initial tile lay?

tileReplacement.question: Must a tile replacement extend existing track?

multiStation.question: Can you lay more than one station marker per turn?
multiStation.answer: No, except by using the special powers of particular privates.

firstStationTiming.question: When is a company's first station marker laid?

twoStationsOneTile.question: Can one train run to two stations on the same tile?

maxRevenue.question: Must the maximum possible revenue be claimed?
maxRevenue.answer: Yes. {The rules make no comment, but the designer's FAQ states that the highest paying route must always be used, and that it is not permitted to claim lower paying routes in order to activate mountain railways and tunnel companies}

forcedTrainAfford.question: When a company is forced to buy a train and cannot buy one with its own means, what train may it then buy?
forcedTrainAfford.answer: Any train from the bank; or any train from another company wishing to sell, at not more than face value.

forcedTrainMinor.question: Must a minor company buy a train if it does not have one?

privateTradeCompany.question: Are private companies purchasable by share companies?
privateTradeCompany.answer: Yes, once a 3 (or 3H) train has been sold, at from 1 to twice face value.

privateClosing.question: Does using a private company's special property close it?
privateClosing.answer: Only the P4, and it then pays 80 to its owner.

answer.effects: 2 trains become 2Hs, green tiles, 2 ORs, privates may be bought by companies, trains     may be bought from other companies, special properties of privates may be used
2H trains rust, 3 trains become 3Hs, train limit 3
Brown tiles, train limit 2, 3 ORs, SBB forms at end of current OR
3H trains rust, 4 trains become 4Hs, companies that have not floated will be fully     capitalised without need to destinate
4H trains rust, 5 trains become 5Hs, grey tiles available

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: At the end of each set of ORs, a train from the bank is 'sold abroad'. This transaction does not involve money, but does get rid of trains, including 'poisoned' ones. The number of station markers a major company gets depends on its flotation price.
